_note: ClinicalTrials.gov lead-sponsor query term -> ticker (collectors/clinicaltrials.py). query.spons is a fuzzy text match, so a short distinctive term suffices. Only INDUSTRY-class sponsors are kept. Two signals: a new Phase-3 START (pipeline advancing) and a trial HALT (TERMINATED/SUSPENDED/WITHDRAWN — a risk flag, recorded but NOT scored into the bullish convergence weight). Mirrors the openFDA drug-maker universe; ADRs -> US ticker.
